name: Can I sue a hospital for medical negligence?
description: You can sue a hospital for negligence by its employees or for systemic failures, though liability for independent doctors can vary.

mainEntity.name: Can I sue a hospital for medical negligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, under certain circumstances, you can sue a hospital for medical negligence. Hospitals can be held liable for the actions of their employees, such as nurses or staff, or for systemic issues like inadequate staffing, faulty equipment, or negligent credentialing of doctors. However, many doctors practicing in hospitals are independent contractors, which can complicate liability. An attorney can help determine if the hospital, individual medical professionals, or both, can be held responsible for your injury.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can sue a hospital for negligence by its employees or for systemic failures, though liability for independent doctors can vary.
